default.text: Boars dig up the jungle edge again. And the cows are scared of anyone who runs at them, so walk slowly, please.

night.text: Stop there! Who walks the fields at night? ...Gods. You're one of them. A shine. Get away from my cows!

night_nell.text: Nell? The tinker's girl from the summer fair? ...A shine got you out. Walk slow past the cows. They scare. Elda's lit; she bakes before dawn.

night_thanks.text: Don't thank me. Just don't run.

night_barn.text: One of you burned my barn last year. With my dog in it. For a quest, he said.

night_hard.text: Then the cows'll trample you, and good riddance.

raided.text: They came over the far fence. Maddy and Tobias are gone, and I stood behind the door with the latch in my hand. Don't tell me it wasn't my fault.

options.text: You'd have been taken with them.
Then don't stand behind the door next time.

raided_kind.text: Maybe. Maddy wouldn't have stayed behind a door for me. That's the part I can't put down.

raided_plain.text: South-east. The Hollow. The cows wouldn't settle till noon; they smelled it.
